name: Raidenmon
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -2] [Raijinmon] x [Fujinmon] x [Suijinmon] 
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 7 or less.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 Digimon card with a play cost 11 or lower and the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
